leadStory: Liverpool, a fortnight after writing the pursuit off at a £128m ask, are now reported confident of beating Arsenal and Bayern to Bradley Barcola, in club-to-club talks with PSG and edging toward a fee near £100m.
subject: A stadium tunnel mouth glowing with light, a single footballer walking back out onto a dark pitch, a door thought closed reopening
